module: Crash camera (automatic slow motion) of freeroam mode. Every frame, it predicts (0.2 s ahead) whether the player's vehicle will hit a traffic/parked vehicle, a wall (static rays) or suffers a sudden speed change; if the speed difference exceeds 13 m/s, it switches to slow motion (simTimeAuthority 0.15), hides the UI and switches to the 'crash' camera or to a camera path. It then restores the previous speed, UI and camera and emits onCrashCamEnded. Loaded by freeroam_crashCamModeLoader according to the enableCrashCam setting.
usage:
-- force activation outside freeroam (e.g. for a scenario) and also track non-traffic vehicles
freeroam_crashCamMode.setForcedEnabled(true)
freeroam_crashCamMode.setTrackingMode(2)
notes: Constants: speed threshold 13 m/s, minimum delay between two triggers 1 s, duration 4 s, lookahead 0.2 s, bounding boxes reduced to 85%, speed check every 0.1 s (threshold +3 m/s).

Three crash modes drawn at random: 1 (45%) close camera above, fixed; 2 (45%) ground camera that rotates; 3 (10%, only if more than 5 s since the last crash cam) time frozen while the camera orbits around the impact point via core_paths.playPath. Crashes against a wall or by speed change only use modes 1 and 2.
Tracking modes (trackingMode): 1 = player against traffic, parked vehicles, walls and speed change; 2 = player against all active vehicles and walls.
Detection is skipped if: a replay is playing, the free camera is active, the simulation time is not 1, the player has just been teleported or there is no player vehicle.

Outside the 'freeroam' game state (and without forcedEnabled), onUpdate sets crashCamEnabled to false permanently until the next onClientStartMission in freeroam or the end of a mission (onAnyMissionChanged 'stopped').
onExtensionLoaded returns false if enableCrashCam is disabled (the extension does not stay loaded in that case, unless the engine ignores the value).
In VR (render_openxr running), the automatic return to the 'external' camera when the vehicle leaves the field of view is not done.
rolloverCheck (rollover) is defined but its call is commented out in onUpdate: never used.
The onCrashCamEnded hook is only emitted if previousCamMode is not nil.

returns.desc: 1 (traffic and walls) or 2 (all active vehicles and walls).

onAnyMissionChanged.desc: Hook called when a mission changes state: disables the crash camera on start ('started'), re-enables it on stop ('stopped').

state.desc: Mission state: 'started' or 'stopped' (other values are ignored).

onBeforeBigMapActivated.desc: Hook called just before the big map opens: stops the crash camera.

onBeforeMenuOpened.desc: Hook called before a menu opens: stops the crash camera if it is active.

onClientEndMission.desc: Hook called at the end of the level: disables the crash camera.

levelPath.desc: Path of the level being left (unused).

onClientStartMission.desc: Hook called when the level starts: enables the crash camera if the game state is 'freeroam'.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook called on load: returns false if the enableCrashCam setting is disabled.

onExtensionUnloaded.desc: Hook called on unload: cleanly stops the crash camera (restores speed, UI and camera).

onReplayStateChanged.desc: Hook called when the replay state changes: stops the crash camera.

onSerialize.desc: Hook called before an extension reload: stops the crash camera.

onTogglePause.desc: Hook called when the game is paused or resumed: stops the crash camera if it is active.

onUpdate.desc: Hook called every frame: detects imminent crashes (traffic, wall, speed change) when the crash camera is inactive; when it is active, tracks its duration, checks the impact between vehicles, starts the camera path in mode 3 and stops it after 4 s or on teleportation.

onVehicleResetted.desc: Hook called when a vehicle is put back in place: stops the crash camera if it is the player's vehicle.

onVehicleSwitched.desc: Hook called when the player vehicle changes: if the crash camera is active, puts the previous camera back on the old vehicle, then stops the crash camera.

oldVehId.desc: Id of the player's old vehicle.

setForcedEnabled.desc: Forces the detection to run even outside freeroam or if the crash camera is disabled.

setTrackingMode.desc: Chooses the tracking mode (1 or 2, see notes).

trackCamMode.desc: To be called when the user changes camera mode: stops the crash camera if it is active (no caller in this file).

trackVehReset.desc: Stops the crash camera (called on vehicle reset; unlike onVehicleResetted, does not check which vehicle).
